reason: Controlled held-out improvement does not establish natural equivalence: only 1 of 18 natural rows is supported, with 8.898 extra predicted gold versus alpha and actual zero. Original puzzle far/near is outside new feature support. Do not extrapolate or silently substitute 0/P1.

baseline.selection: Original exact 18 ids, no new success/outcome filtering. Natural rows are evaluation only. Contact timing/15/30 tick weight shares are post-hoc diagnostics only.

controlled.tacticalPolicy: Installed native continueV7Creep in its original general slot plus native local tactics, claim/onCommands and public SDK; version v9_archer. Economy and strategic target selection excluded, not full owner-think acceptance. Formation/cooldown seeds vary; simulator deterministic.
controlled.outcome: Win = camp cleared in the attempt. Native retreat that terminates the task is non-win, not a promised eventual mission failure. Clearing can be known while post-clear loss label remains censored. Raw positive damage/deaths/healing/residual windows retained.

parameters.criterion: sum weighted squared errors for zero-loss, win, and casualty/capital

model.support: Exact own-kind set, full guard-kind roster, worker count, consumable decision; each covariate within observed finite training range. Unsupported compositions/levels/terrain/dispersion remain pending. No map feature or map correction. Min/max support is a conservative rectangular screening, not a proof of all joint combinations.
model.expectedGold: (1-Pzero)*sum(conditional_probability*min(cohort_native_capital,conditional_gold)); no added margin, wounds and consumable price excluded from death labels.

validation.holdout: Leave one source map out, excluding every controlled derivative from its source map. Fit controlled rows only. Control anchor total weight 1; natural diagnostic rows not trained. No per-map parameter tuning.
validation.alphaBoundary: Same native assessAllocatedCampBattle alpha=0.19. For natural camp-only comparison retain exact onset cohort/guards/HP and exclude external world from BOTH models, not as a planner fact. Full-world alpha remained unknown due enemy arrival facts and is not converted to 0. Alpha has no calibrated Pzero: table zero label is its deterministic predicted death-gold==0 indicator.
validation.zeroLossFalsePositiveDefinitions: Counts with positive expected cost and with P(loss)>.5 are both reported; a positive expectation is not a binary assertion that this particular fight must lose a unit.

turtleDiagnosis.interpretation: Removing natural fitting and adding initial-pose dispersion/terrain descriptors changes support. The lower supported bias is NOT proof the natural turtle problem is fixed; all four turtle natural rows are now unsupported. Observed contact dispersal occurs on twoShores too, so no turtle-specific correction.

integration.consumable: Pure none/use alternatives preserve native actual carrier, cooldown and shop price. Runtime use action still needs one-shot shared item balance/carrier lease; not executable here. Only healingScroll/guardianScroll controlled; neutral automatic items/reusable-active mixed policies pending.
integration.workers: Worker-k controls exist, with actual native DPS and combatRating=0. Worker foregone income remains missing/null until same-think economic oracle, and is not folded into death label or charged twice with allocator opportunity cost. No live worker-k provider registered.
integration.puzzle1: Far/near original snapshot/cohort immutable, conditional pure quotation only; new model outside feature support. Existing alpha remains. No public puzzle/owner-think acceptance claim.
